name: Rooibos tea
where: Tea shops near Company's Garden or Woolworths
about: A caffeine-free herbal tea made from South African rooibos plant leaves. It is grown only in the Cederberg region, so it is a strong local keepsake from Cape Town.
tip: Buy pure rooibos. Check that the packet has no plant seeds mixed in.

name: Cape Malay masala
about: A spice blend used in Cape Malay cooking, which grew out of the city's mix of cultures. It is closely tied to the colorful Bo-Kaap neighborhood.
tip: Check the grind date on the package so the spices still smell strong.
